The '''rikknit''' was a crustacean native to [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. They had eight to twelve legs and lived at the tops of [[hiakk tree]]s. Rikknit spun webs for nests and storage. Female rikknit had ovum sacs connected to their abdomens. The [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]] removed these to harvest [[Rikknit egg|their eggs]], which were sold offworld as a delicacy. They also harvested ovum sacks from rikknit and processed them into an addictive substance called [[ji rikknit]].

Rikknits were hunted with [[harvest blade]]s before [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] declared them a protected species.
